slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize total profit (revenue minus raw material cost minus processing cost) or to minimize total cost?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and the metric (profit vs cost), directly covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 slot (objective) was resolved in turn 1, but the agent then repeated the identical integer-vs-fractional question roughly twenty times, continuing with repeated low-value questions after resolution.

summary: The agent correctly recovered the P0 objective in the first turn but then got stuck in a loop, repeating the same integer/fractional question many times without ever reaching a modeling state, showing severe over-questioning.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
